title: BARD — Quadruped Robot Dog
description: BARD is a custom quadruped robot dog built with 12 degrees of freedom, taking inspiration from Boston Dynamics SPOT. Capable of walking, running, and jumping.

title: ESP32 Smart Watch with Navigation
description: My custom ESP32 smartwatch/deskbot with programmed emotions that can also work as a wrist-mounted navigation system.

title: Custom Musical Instruments
description: A custom wired dual-humbucker bass guitar, a custom pickguard with switch configuration for my Fender Squier, and my own hollowbody guitar (still in progress).
